correctness.rationale: The projective correspondence is scheme-local because its radial equation has nonzero derivative. The binary cubic coefficient map is bijective with matrices; direct parameterization of repeated linear factors enumerates every odd-characteristic double/triple root and divides by the full GL2 count. Characteristic two derivative invertibility excludes multiple roots. The independent standalone exhaustive finite-field checker agrees at q=2,3,4,5,7. Infinite generality follows from algebraic counting, not enumeration.

value.rationale: The geometric nonreduced locus is the intrinsic failure of etaleness of the length-three nonzero-idempotent scheme. Its exact finite-field density, the characteristic split and the double-versus-triple singularity strata quantify a natural discriminant boundary directly motivated by the survey’s Galois and idempotent-scheme programme. This is not just a restatement of the rational fixed-point count: schemes with one rational point can be separable or have a triple root.
